chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
There is no servant who asks without need except that he will die before Allah, Mighty and Majestic, makes him in need of it, and writes for him thereby the Fire.

key_terms.النَّارَ: the Fire, meaning punishment in the hereafter
key_terms.يُحْوِجَهُ: causes him to become in need

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about asking for things without real need?
ai.summary: This hadith warns against asking others for things without genuine need. It teaches that such conduct brings humiliation in this world and punishment in the hereafter, stressing dignity, restraint, and moral responsibility in seeking material help.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1754 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"No servant asks [for something] without need except that they will die before Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious, makes them truly in need of it, and it will be written against them as [a cause for] the Fire."
